profile.headline: Software Developer at Epic
profile.summary:
I love to learn and have fun. I've been excited about programming ever since I took my first undergraduate course on the subject, and I look forward to continue learning new and relevant languages. It's always fun to see what new technologies are being released and how they are utilized in software development. I hope to work for an awesome company that prioritizes quality, for both the company and the consumer. 

Feel free to check out my website: http://aconstantino.com


Other Accomplishments

• I designed an eagle project and lead approximately 13 boy scouts and 10 adults, performing 87 man hours, cleaning up a camp ground in Idaho

• I served for 3 years, during high school, with the Athletic Trainer doing Sports Medicine for football, basketball, track, and soccer teams. My duties included injury care and prevention during athletic games and practices, serving over 300 hours.

• I served as a Representative of a global church organization for 2 years in Costa Rica. I served as a leader of 3-4 groups, of 6 people each, helping them create and achieve goals.

• I taught six 5th grade students anatomy, health and nutrition at Greenwood Elementary School for 8 weeks.

• I was employed as a Teaching Assistant in the Computer Science Department for 1 year at Brigham Young University. I helped 2 different sophomore level classes of 350-450 students write code to solve problems and write code as computer programmers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Team Leadership · Agile Project Management · Git · MATLAB

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Used C++ to develop four live table games (Dynasty Baccarat, Single-zero/Double-zero Roulette, Blackjack, and Sic Bo) into an existing product purchase from a third party
Used C#/Unity to develop new RNG/Live table games on Ascent platform
Owned and maintained specific features of the products and drives their development to completion

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with project management to dynamically automate trading reports for clients
Developed in T-SQL
Performed database management
Completed side projects in Java, Python, XML/XSD, VBA

positions.title: CS Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CS 235 – Data Structures course
Taught concepts to students several times a week
Helped students to develop the skills to write projects
Aided students in understanding techniques of debugging to apply to their code
Wrote and tested new projects for the course
